_how: Edit in Pages CMS (Library), or by hand. One entry per pick. shelf: books, music or movies (Movies and TV). format (music): vinyl, cd or cassette. title, by, year; genre for books. why: your line. take: optional short review. updated: YYYY-MM-DD; the newest four on each shelf show on /offline/, every pick on /offline/library/. cover: an image in offline/covers/ (written as /offline/covers/name). Leave it empty and the library-covers Action finds one; your own image always wins.

picks.title: Orbital
picks.why: One earth day from the space station. A beautiful story, somehow with no actual plot.

picks.title: Vagabond
picks.why: A fascinating life explored through his most iconic roles (including Home Alone 2!)
Taking off one day a week from tech is a life-changing decision.

picks.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
picks.why: An excellent intro to the LitRPG genre. But be ready for lots of weird.

picks.title: Bewitched
picks.why: A go-to for any cocktail party, or just an evening of soft vocals that never miss.

picks.title: Cinema
picks.why: Starts with the well known “Experience” but never stops being a great listen.

picks.title: Everybody Scream
picks.why: Poetry. And a call to action for society and for each person who hears it.

picks.title: The Joshua Tree
picks.why: One of the best A sides ever released. And guitars that defined a genre.

picks.title: The Fugitive
picks.why: Early 90s action that has aged incredibly well into the 21st century.

picks.title: The Iron Giant
picks.why: The classic that made Ted Lasso’s Greyhounds cry. As it should.

picks.title: The Italian Job
picks.why: One of the best heist movies ever made. It’s a good train, you should get on it!

picks.title: Chocolat
picks.why: Starts as a simple story, but becomes something so much more. And the score is awesome.
